versions.changelog:
Investor Update Generator initial release.

- Quickly generate structured, professional investor updates based on company metrics and milestones.
- Includes templates for Pre-Seed to Series A stages, with clear update structure and writing guidelines.
- Built-in metrics dashboard, product & engineering updates, team changes, and cash/runway tracking.
- Specific advice on update frequency, what to include, and common red flags to avoid.
- Provides example subject lines and formatting for clarity and consistency.
- Benchmarks table and resource links for further context and financial planning.
